view_frame: The drawing presents two views. The left view (Front) shows the upright panel face, establishing the X (width) and Z (height) axes. The right view (Side) shows the L-shaped profile, establishing the Y (depth) and Z (height) axes. The base extends in the +Y direction from the panel.

features.placement: Centered at X=0, Z=0. Extends from Y=0 to Y=base_depth. Top surface at Z=base_thickness.
features.evidence: Horizontal leg of the L-shape in the right view.

features.placement: Centered at X=0, Y=0. Extends from Z=0 to Z=panel_height. Extends from Y=0 to Y=panel_thickness.
features.evidence: Vertical leg of the L-shape in the right view; outer boundary of the left view.

features.placement: Bottom-left quadrant of the panel face. Centered at X=-panel_width/4, Z=panel_height/4.
features.evidence: Bottom-left rectangular outline in the left view.

features.evidence: Top-right rectangular outline in the left view.

connections: The base_plate and upright_panel share a common volume at the corner (X=0, Y=0, Z=0) to form a watertight L-shape.
The four openings are subtractive features applied to the upright_panel.
edit_rules: Changing panel_width must update base_width and the X-positions of all openings.
Changing panel_height must update the Z-positions of all openings.
Changing panel_thickness must update the depth of all openings to ensure they remain through-holes.
Changing base_thickness must update the Z-position of the panel base to maintain the L-shape connection.
unresolved: All dimensions are missing from the drawing and are marked as ASSUMED based on visual proportions.
The specific wall thickness of the panel is not dimensioned; assumed uniform with base thickness.
